Exam trapsPrompt caching the tool defini: Exam Trap: Prompt caching the tool definitions solves context bloat from a large multi-server catalogue. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Caching cuts the price of repeated definitions, but every definition still occupies context and still counts toward the selection-accuracy limit. Only tool search removes definitions from context.Deferring every tool is always the most efficient choice, even for a small set of tools that are all used constantly. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Each deferred tool costs a search turn before it can be called. Frequently used tools should stay loaded so Claude can call them directly.
Only the rubric average is specific, mea: มีเพียงค่าเฉลี่ยของรูบริกเท่านั้นที่มีความเฉพาะเจาะจง วัดได้ บรรลุผลได้ และมีความเกี่ยวข้อง: ระดับคุณภาพที่มีการกำหนดไว้อย่างดีโดยเฉลี่ยจากชุดที่ยึดไว้ตายตัว ซึ่งช่วยให้สามารถตอบกลับแต่ละรายการได้ไม่สมบูรณ์ ตัวเลือกอื่นๆ ผิดด้วยเหตุผลที่แตกต่างกัน “เครื่องอุ่น” ไม่มีการวัดผล คะแนนที่สมบูรณ์แบบจากทุกคนไม่สามารถทำได้ การอนุมัติโดยหัวหน้าทีมเป็นกระบวนการตรวจสอบ ไม่ใช่เกณฑ์ และจะทำให้มนุษย์เป็นผู้ให้คะแนนการวิ่งทุกครั้ง
Exam trapAn SDK agent that has lost Clau: Exam Trap: An SDK agent that has lost Claude Code's behaviour must be skipping CLAUDE.md, because the SDK loads no filesystem settings by default. (ทำไมถึงผิด): When settingSources is unset it follows the CLI defaults and loads all sources. The usual gap is the minimal default system prompt, which you fix with the claude_code preset.
Exam trapSetting thinking display to \"o: Exam Trap: Setting thinking display to "omitted" cuts thinking costs, because the thinking text is not returned. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Omitted display skips streaming the thinking text, which lowers latency, but every thinking token is still generated and billed.
Exam trapPrefilling the Assistant turn i: Exam Trap: Prefilling the Assistant turn is a dependable way to enforce a template's output format on any Claude model. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Prefill appears in older consistency guidance, but it is not supported on Claude 4.6 and later or on Claude Mythos Preview. On those models, define the format precisely and show it with examples.
Exam trapWhen a RAG assistant invents a: Exam Trap: When a RAG assistant invents a figure, let it supplement gaps in the documents with its general knowledge. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Drawing on general knowledge is how ungrounded figures get in. The fix is to restrict Claude to the provided documents, require quotes first, and allow it to say it does not know.
Exam trapMore examples are always better: Exam Trap: More examples are always better, so start with as many as you can write. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Start with one example and add more only if the output still misses, because Claude also picks up any accidental pattern the examples share.
Exam trapLeaving the tools field off a s: Exam Trap: Leaving the tools field off a subagent definition keeps it limited and safe. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Omitting tools gives the subagent every tool available to subagents. To keep a reviewer read-only, list only Read and Grep.
Exam trapClearing thinking blocks is fre: Exam Trap: Clearing thinking blocks is free context: it saves tokens with no other cost. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Clearing thinking invalidates the prompt cache at the clearing point. Keeping the blocks preserves cache hits, so keep is a choice between cache performance and window space.
Exam trapNon-determinism is a quirk of A: Exam Trap: Non-determinism is a quirk of Anthropic's own API; running Claude through a third-party cloud provider returns identical outputs for identical inputs. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Identical inputs can produce different outputs on Anthropic's first-party inference service and on third-party cloud providers alike.
Exam trapTeam-shared rules belong in man: Exam Trap: Team-shared rules belong in managed-settings.json because it reaches every machine. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Team conventions that go through code review belong in the committed.claude/settings.json. Managed settings are deployed by the organization for security policy, and developers do not edit them.
Exam trapWhen costs are too high, the fi: Exam Trap: When costs are too high, the first move is to switch to a cheaper model. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Lowering effort on the current model is usually the better first lever. Switching tiers comes after an effort sweep on your evals.
Exam trapA plugin's hooks and MCP server: Exam Trap: A plugin's hooks and MCP servers run inside Claude Code's sandbox, so installing a plugin is low-risk. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Claude Code runs both outside the sandbox, and command hooks run with your full user permissions.
Exam trapPer-session identifiers are opt: Exam Trap: Per-session identifiers are opt-in, so metrics stay small unless you add attributes yourself. (ทำไมถึงผิด): session.id and the account attributes are included on metrics by default. To keep the number of time series down, turn off the flags your dashboards don't group by.
Exam trapIf a model switch mid-conversat: Exam Trap: If a model switch mid-conversation drops prior thinking, the API returns an error. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Blocks the new model can't read are removed without warning, the request returns 200, and the removed blocks aren't billed.
Exam trapA live A/B test is the quickest: Exam Trap: A live A/B test is the quickest way to find out whether a prompt revision is better. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Live A/B tests take days or weeks to reach significance and need enough traffic. An offline eval on a held-out set is the fast first check, and A/B testing then validates significant changes.
Exam trapServer tools such as web_search: Exam Trap: Server tools such as web_search need your code to execute them and return tool_result blocks. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Anthropic runs server tools and their loop. Your code enables the tool and handles pause_turn, but never builds their results.
Exam trapsSetting effort to max guarante: Exam Trap: Setting effort to max guarantees the deepest reasoning and removes the risk of an incomplete result. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Effort is soft guidance and Claude still decides per request whether to think. On most workloads max adds a lot of cost for small gains, and simple subagent work belongs at low.Lowering effort is the way to make Claude's visible answers shorter. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Effort controls thinking volume, not the length of the visible reply. On Claude Opus 5 it does not reliably shorten responses, so prompt for length instead.
Exam trapA PostToolUse hook can act as a: Exam Trap: A PostToolUse hook can act as a guardrail that stops a dangerous tool call. (ทำไมถึงผิด): PostToolUse fires after the tool has already run and cannot block it. Use PreToolUse, which can block the call, for deterministic prevention.
Exam trapAny token signed by the organiz: Exam Trap: Any token signed by the organization's authorization server can be used with any of its MCP servers, and forwarding it to backend APIs saves a second token request. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Tokens are bound to one server's canonical URI. A server that accepts other audiences lets tokens be reused across services, and forwarding them creates a confused deputy.
Exam trapsA task with several subtasks n: Exam Trap: A task with several subtasks needs orchestrator-workers. (ทำไมถึงผิด): When the subtasks are known in advance, plain parallelization (sectioning) is simpler and fits better. Orchestrator-workers is for subtasks that only become clear once the specific input arrives.Running two different checks on the same code at the same time is voting. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Voting repeats the same task to get diverse outputs. Two different checks running in parallel is sectioning.
Exam trapA locally running HTTP MCP serv: Exam Trap: A locally running HTTP MCP server should bind to 0.0.0.0 so every client can reach it. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Local servers should bind only to localhost, and must validate the Origin header to prevent DNS rebinding.
Exam trapOnce you use an SDK, no header: Exam Trap: Once you use an SDK, no header is your responsibility any more. (ทำไมถึงผิด): The SDK sends the authentication, version and content-type headers, but anthropic-workspace-id depends on your key, so you pass it yourself when the key needs it.
Exam trapUnder ZDR, the API rejects requ: Exam Trap: Under ZDR, the API rejects requests that use non-eligible features, just as it does under HIPAA readiness. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Only HIPAA readiness rejects them. Under ZDR the request goes through, and that data falls under the feature's own retention policy.
Exam trapAs long as the input fits insid: Exam Trap: As long as the input fits inside the context window, the model's recall is as good as on a short prompt. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Accuracy and recall degrade as token count grows, well before the hard limit. The limit is a separate cliff on top of that gradual decline.
Exam trapFast mode swaps in a smaller, l: Exam Trap: Fast mode swaps in a smaller, less capable model to get its speed. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Fast mode runs the same Opus model with the same weights on a faster inference setup. It costs a premium and does not reduce capability.
Exam trapWhen an organization delivers b: Exam Trap: When an organization delivers both server-managed settings and a managed-settings.json file, Claude Code merges the two documents. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Under the default first-wins behaviour, only the highest-ranked source that carries a policy key applies, and the rest are skipped silently. /status shows which source was used. Merging requires managedSourcesBehavior set to merge.
Exam trapThe per-user TPM measured in a: Exam Trap: The per-user TPM measured in a small pilot can be multiplied by the full headcount to size the organization's allocation. (ทำไมถึงผิด): The recommended per-user TPM and RPM fall as team size grows. Size a 300-user organization from the 100–500 row, not from the small-team row.
Exam trapPutting your own follow-up inst: Exam Trap: Putting your own follow-up instructions inside a tool_result is a convenient way to steer Claude after a tool call. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Claude treats tool-result content as untrusted data, so instructions placed there may be ignored or flagged as an injection. Send them in the user turn that follows.
Exam trapA Bash deny rule or allowlist s: Exam Trap: A Bash deny rule or allowlist sandboxes the agent and contains what a command can do. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Permission rules match command text. Claude Code says this is a permission gate, not a sandbox; use OS-level sandboxing to restrict filesystem and network access.
Exam trapSplitting a prompt into a chain: Exam Trap: Splitting a prompt into a chain makes the system faster because each call is smaller. (ทำไมถึงผิด): A chain runs its calls in sequence, so it is slower. It accepts that latency in exchange for accuracy, because each call has an easier job.
Exam trapA small set of carefully hand-g: Exam Trap: A small set of carefully hand-graded cases gives a better eval than a large automatically graded one. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Volume beats per-case quality. Grading is paid again on every run, so automated grading across many cases gives usable signal on every change.
Exam trapsThe 5-minute cache lifetime st: Exam Trap: The 5-minute cache lifetime starts when the response finishes, so a long generation does not eat into it. (ทำไมถึงผิด): The lifetime runs from the start of the request that wrote or read the entry. A 4-minute stream leaves about 1 minute to send the follow-up.Every extra cache_control breakpoint adds to the cost of a request. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Breakpoints are free. Charges come only from cache writes, cache reads and uncached input tokens.
Exam trapAn AGENTS.md always loads along: Exam Trap: An AGENTS.md always loads alongside the project CLAUDE.md. (ทำไมถึงผิด): By default, AGENTS.md loads only when there is no CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md in the working directory or above it. To get both, use an @AGENTS.md import or the claude-md-and-agents-md setting.
Exam trapBecause Anthropic defines the b: Exam Trap: Because Anthropic defines the bash and text_editor schemas, Anthropic also executes those tools. (ทำไมถึงผิด): They are client tools. Anthropic supplies the schema, but your application runs each call and returns the tool_result. Only server tools such as web_search run on Anthropic's side.
Exam trapA raw HTTP call only needs an A: Exam Trap: A raw HTTP call only needs an API key and a JSON content type, and the API version is implied by the model. (ทำไมถึงผิด): anthropic-version is required on every request. The SDKs hide this because they add it automatically, along with the authentication and content-type headers.
Exam trapThe Message Batches API speeds: Exam Trap: The Message Batches API speeds up a workload as well as making it cheaper. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Batching trades latency for its 50% discount. Results can take up to 24 hours and streaming isn't supported, so it suits only work that can wait.
Exam trapInconsistent label spelling and: Exam Trap: Inconsistent label spelling and formatting is a reasoning problem, so asking Claude to explain its choice in prose will fix it. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Format and label drift is what examples fix. A few well-crafted, tagged examples improve consistency, while extra reasoning prose does not change the shape of the output.
Exam trapEach extra cache_control breakp: Exam Trap: Each extra cache_control breakpoint adds to the bill, so you should use as few as possible. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Breakpoints are free. Cost depends only on how many tokens are written to and read from cache.
Exam trapA dependency version range reso: Exam Trap: A dependency version range resolves against the version string in the dependency's plugin.json. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Ranges resolve against git tags, so a release that is never tagged cannot be selected. For a plugin referenced by a relative path, the marketplace's current copy is installed and the range is checked at load.
Exam trapsAdding the code-review plugin: Exam Trap: Adding the code-review plugin to a workflow is enough for findings to appear on the PR. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Without --comment, Claude posts nothing to the PR, and the findings exist only in the workflow run log.Choosing "After every push" costs the same as reviewing once, just with fresher results. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Every push triggers a full review, so cost scales with the number of pushes to the PR.
Exam trapA stdio server can print debug: Exam Trap: A stdio server can print debug output to stdout, and the client will filter it out. (ทำไมถึงผิด): stdout may carry only valid MCP messages. Logging belongs on stderr, which clients should not treat as a sign of errors.
Exam trapOn Claude Sonnet 5.5, between_t: Exam Trap: On Claude Sonnet 5.5, between_tools works at any effort level, just like adaptive thinking. (ทำไมถึงผิด): between_tools is only accepted at low, medium and high effort. At xhigh or max it returns a 400.
Exam trapPutting your own guidance insid: Exam Trap: Putting your own guidance inside a tool_result is the most reliable way to steer how Claude handles that content. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Claude treats tool-result content as untrusted, so instructions you put there may be ignored or flagged as injection. Put them in a following user turn.
Exam trapLoading every past finding into: Exam Trap: Loading every past finding into the context at the start of each session is the right way to give an agent long-term memory. (ทำไมถึงผิด): The memory tool keeps knowledge in files and reads them back only when needed, so the active context stays focused on the current task.
Exam trapSplitting work across parallel: Exam Trap: Splitting work across parallel agents is the way to deliver results faster. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Parallel agents buy thoroughness. They typically use 3 to 10 times more tokens and often take longer overall than a single agent, because there is so much more total computation.
Exam trapFast mode swaps in a smaller, f: Exam Trap: Fast mode swaps in a smaller, faster model, so you trade some intelligence for speed. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Fast mode uses the same model weights and behaviour on a faster inference configuration. Only output speed and price change.
Exam trapOnce an LLM grader exists, huma: Exam Trap: Once an LLM grader exists, human review is no longer needed. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Model-based graders are non-deterministic and need calibration against human graders. Systematic human review stays in the framework to do that calibration.
Exam trapA JSON server entry with just a: Exam Trap: A JSON server entry with just a url is enough, because Claude Code infers HTTP from the URL. (ทำไมถึงผิด): An entry without a type is read as stdio, so a url entry must set type to http, sse, or ws.
Exam trapSending chunks as search_result: Exam Trap: Sending chunks as search_result blocks is enough to make Claude cite them. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Citations are off by default. Set citations.enabled to true, and use the same setting for every search result in the request.
Exam trapA design is ready for approval: Exam Trap: A design is ready for approval once you can tell stakeholders it carries no risk. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Residual risk is stated as specific and bounded: a limited write surface, a named worst case, and audit coverage that surfaces problems quickly. Spend limits bound cost risk the same way.
Exam trapA refusal stop_reason on a 200: Exam Trap: A refusal stop_reason on a 200 response means the integration sent a broken request. (ทำไมถึงผิด): A refusal means the model declined, even though the request was processed successfully. Handle it by reading stop_details and retrying on a fallback model.
Exam trapSetting HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PR: Exam Trap: Setting HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY is enough to force all agent traffic through a credential-injecting proxy. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Some tools ignore the proxy variables, and a proxy that does not terminate TLS cannot see inside requests to inject into them. Remove the agent's network interface and terminate TLS at the proxy.
Exam trapIf the new version's overall sc: Exam Trap: If the new version's overall score is at least as good, it is safe to promote. (ทำไมถึงผิด): A change aimed at one segment can quietly take accuracy from another. A broad routing rule for API tickets halved billing accuracy while every other team stayed at 5/5.
Exam trapsThe Messages API MCP connector: Exam Trap: The Messages API MCP connector can use a local stdio server if you give it the command or process path to launch. (ทำไมถึงผิด): The connector only connects to servers publicly exposed over HTTP (Streamable HTTP or SSE) at an https:// URL. A stdio server must first be deployed as a remote server.Attaching a server through the MCP connector exposes its tools, resources and prompts to Claude. (ทำไมถึงผิด): The connector supports only the tool-call part of the MCP specification. Resources and prompts need a full MCP client such as Claude Code.
Exam trapManaged Agents counts as runnin: Exam Trap: Managed Agents counts as running the agent on your own infrastructure, because your service drives it. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Managed Agents runs the agent and its sandbox in Anthropic's infrastructure. Only the Agent SDK runs the loop and tools inside a process you operate.
Exam trapA follow-up query() automatical: Exam Trap: A follow-up query() automatically reaches the subagent that ran in the previous query. (ทำไมถึงผิด): Each query() starts a new session. You must resume the earlier session by its ID and name the agent ID to continue that subagent's transcript.
Exam trapsWhen costs are too high, the f: Exam Trap: When costs are too high, the first step is to move to a cheaper model. To the central collector, because manage: สําหรับคอลเลกเตอร์ส่วนกลาง เนื่องจากการตั้งค่าที่มีการจัดการจะแทนที่คีย์การวัดระยะไกลทั้งหมด
Nowhere, because Claude Code refuses to: ไม่มีที่ใดเลย เพราะ Claude Code ปฏิเสธที่จะเริ่มต้นเมื่อการตั้งค่าขัดแย้งกัน
Managed transport settings take priority: การตั้งค่าการขนส่งที่มีการจัดการมีลําดับความสําคัญสูงกว่าการตั้งค่าของนักพัฒนาที่ตรงกัน การตั้งค่า OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT จะลบตําแหน่งข้อมูลต่อสัญญาณทั้งหมดที่นักพัฒนาได้ตั้งค่าไว้ ดังนั้นจึงไม่มีใครสามารถส่งสัญญาณหนึ่งไปยังคอลเลกเตอร์อื่นได้ การตั้งค่า OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP-PROTOCOL ทําเช่นเดียวกันสําหรับโปรโตคอล ข้อมูลประจําตัวจะก้าวไปอีกขั้น เมื่อการตั้งค่าที่มีการจัดการให้ OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS หรือคีย์หรือใบรับรองของไคลเอ็นต์ Claude Code จะลบตําแหน่งข้อมูลทั้งหมดที่นักพัฒนาได้ตั้งค่าไว้ด้วย มิฉะนั้นโทเค็นของคุณอาจถูกส่งไปยังคอลเลกเตอร์ที่คุณไม่ได้เลือก
Exporter selectors are the gap. OTEL_MET: ตัวเลือกตัวส่งออกคือช่องว่าง OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER, OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER และ OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER ปฏิบัติตามลําดับความสําคัญตามคีย์ปกติ ดังนั้นสิ่งใดก็ตามที่คุณละเว้นจากการตั้งค่าที่มีการจัดการสามารถเปลี่ยนแปลงได้บนเครื่องแต่ละเครื่อง ตัวเลือกที่ตั้งค่าไว้สําหรับคอนโซลเป็นกรณีที่ชัดเจนที่สุดของการวัดระยะไกลที่ไม่เคยมาถึง ผลลัพธ์จะปรากฏในเทอร์มินัลของนักพัฒนานั้นและที่อื่นใดไม่ได้ ดังนั้นทีมความสามารถในการสังเกตการณ์จึงไม่ได้รับมุมมองส่วนกลาง ช่วงเวลาการส่งออกเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของการตั้งค่าที่มีการจัดการเช่นกัน ย่อให้สั้นลงระหว่างการแก้จุดบกพร่อง จากนั้นรีเซ็ตเพื่อการผลิต ซึ่งค่าเริ่มต้นของเมตริกคือ 60 วินาที

plus every developer-set endpoint variab: บวกกับตัวแปรตําแหน่งข้อมูลที่นักพัฒนาตั้งค่าไว้ ไม่ว่าจะเป็นแบบทั่วไปหรือแบบต่อสัญญาณ เนื่องจากข้อมูลประจําตัวเหล่านั้นจะเข้าถึงตัวรวบรวมที่การตั้งค่าที่มีการจัดการไม่ได้เลือก
